title: Distribute a model artifact backup standard across an organization
prompt: You want to enforce the same backup plan for model artifacts across multiple accounts. Which two actions are required?

choices.text: Manually create the same policy in each member account.
choices.explanation: This does not use a centrally attached policy that member accounts inherit, so it does not provide ongoing centralized governance.

choices.text: Enable trusted access between AWS Backup and Organizations.
choices.explanation: AWS Backup requires trusted access with Organizations to use organization policies.

choices.text: Delete CloudTrail to speed up backup processing.
choices.explanation: Deleting audit trails is neither a prerequisite for nor a means of distributing backup policies.

choices.text: Standardize model names to copy them automatically to every account.
choices.explanation: Standardizing names alone does not distribute protection plans or retention requirements.

choices.text: Create a backup policy in the management account and attach it to the target OU or accounts.
choices.explanation: A backup policy can be attached to the organization root, an OU, or an account.

learning.reason: Trusted access and policy attachment make recovery controls consistent across the organization.
